title: camissoniopsis cheiranthifolia subsp. suffruticosa
intro: Camissoniopsis cheiranthifolia subsp. suffruticosa, commonly known as Western spongy gilia, is a shrubby perennial plant belonging to the Polemoniaceae family. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating wounds, infections, and other health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Western spongy gilia include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
